content: Jesus barasam duruk wonong te namaram
O Theophilus,
aninga batoga giriwuk la mu te mu, ani Jesus ura duap beteram ale mel suen la bitakaso, ale kariimet nunga kausa ura bitakaso,

ale tai tom nu barasam duruk wonong te namaram, mu ko dugu duap ani bataguru saperem. Ale barasuk duruk wonong te namarukko se Bur Laili ko sokel te olekem alo nu nunga atumukiram mu den sangam nungaram.

Nu ikup yaman giam ale kueram, bare tom nu barasam mu ko kariari mu nongote, lage suen biya te nu marak bagoso mu ko nongomang ningi nunguning arukko numi wetang awukaso. Nu day tom 40 ko baga se numi nunga kasurukaso, ale Kaem ko kingdom ko karogo la nunga manarukaso.

Ale tom bo nu nongorak daigam ale na no se den sangam iwita nunga maonam, “Nina Jerusalem me beteralko. Nina aninga Ait ko munan ningarukko ko gomang, se ani ko ninga manarukasam umutang ko kimi beteralko.
Mu awuk, John yu te kariimet anuwa marak nungarukaso. Bare tom maiya mena nina Bur Laili ko sokel te baptais talko,” mam.
Se ilak biguwuman baga se mu isarman, “Kari Biya, ni aitakta tom ewere te Israel sor lilim, kuwim kuwim te bitar se pila kota sanamarukko e?” maman.
Se nu nunga maonam, “Day tom Ba kota ko nup biya ko pulawura bowa ningi balu awuram mu, nina ikialko mel bo mena.
Bare Bur Laili nengete tai kaparuk mu tom mu te nina sokel talko; ale nina aninga dugu duap balu balu Jerusalem ningi, Judea se Samaria ningi, se ali lilim la te geragalko,” mam.
Nu den mu balu kutuwuram, mu nuna nomotam te barasam tarigiram namakaso, se taiti nuwi bo tairam kaluwuram se nomotam ko yumuram.
Nuna yam taiti kuali loagawaman mu me kam la kari ilagala nunga guang siraram mu aratu nongorak sanamaman.

Ale maman, “Galilee kari alo, nina anape ko sanamaman ale taiti kuali loaga lagasan a? Jesus Kaem aru tam se duruk wonong te namaram nukung mu, nina ariwaman se namaram uwutatala maingte aking peleruk tai kaparukko.”
Matthias atumu kereman se Judas kuwim tam
Asele nuna peleman duruk gotek balsan Duruk Olive masan mu beteman, ale Jerusalem namaman. Duruk Olive mu Jerusalem duap te, ko awar mu 1 kilometre iwita.

Nuna nama arataman mu kawam ningi kasu naguman ale galung kualala nuna te bagakasan mu te nama tarigiman. Kariari tom umu te bagakasan mu nunga nunup: Peter, John, James, se Andrew; Philip se Thomas, Bartholomew se Matthew; se James bo tala Alphaeus ko namar, se Simon Zealot, se Judas, nu kari bo nup James tala wore ko namar.
Nuna se Maria, Jesus ko nuam, se ko uriamitak, se imet sang ago tala mu am guranek te la bagakasan.
Day tom sang namaram se nongomang ningi nunguning alo 120 iwita tai ilu biguwuman se Peter barasu sanamaram,

ale mam, “Aga singsang, girakala Bur Laili ikia David tuam, se te Judas ko den balam se batoga te aniso mu ko nunguning kaparam. Judas mu nu kari borta kager kari nunga kiti gurugam se namaman Jesus ilu talipaman.
Nu anananga ningi nanga bo, nu anananga ura suan se nanga bagara suan.”
Judas ko munan memek umu ko koma manga tam ale ali bilik bo diaram. Ale ali nukung te dagulam ale tuagu pagam se nulis woyam aratam.
Se kariimet suen la Jerusalem bagara mu ko den mu ikiman, ale ali mu nunga den te nup beteman Akeldama maman. Nup mu ko nunguning mu Ali Gue ago.
Se Peter den kunasaram ale mam, “Psalm ko batoga ningi iwita batagorman se aniso:

content.text: ‘Noko sor mu dulurmon se ipi anirukko,

content: se,

content.text: ‘Kari bo noko kuwim te ko ura mu taukko.’

content: Bore te se noko kuwim te mu, ana kariari alo nangarak pempem Kari Biya Jesus ilak lagaman,

tom nu John kuting te anuwa marak tam tai aitak nu nanga beteram ale barasam namaram, kariari imitang bo atumu kerenak se ana nangarak ura tauk ale kueram ale kumik guang ago lilim barasam umu ko dugu duap wetang te balu balu geragukko.”
Peter uwuta balam, se nuna kari ilagala nunga balu gilingiman. Bo Joseph, ko nup bo Barsabbas, se ko nup bo tala Justus. Se kari bo mu Matthias.
Asele guranek te Kaem aru manorman ale maman, “Kari Biya, ni kariimet suen la nunga nongomang motam arigisam. Ilagala imi nunga ningi awiriya ni atumukirem mu nanga kasuru
se apostle ura imi Judas kuwim te giokko. Judas kuwim beteram ale sor nu te namarukko wore te namaram,” maman.
Uwuta guranek beteman, ale te ikimonko kolara bo kolaman, se manga gotek te kolaman mu Matthias kote dagulam. Se nu eng am apostle 11 mu nunga bo ko aratam.

footnotes.text: Nup Theophilus ko nunguning mu “kari Kaem ko kueso”. Luke 1:3 ago arikko.
Bur Laili ko den: Matthew 3:11; John 14:16-17; Acts 2:33.
Sabbath ko munan te Juda alo lage ko maiya uwuta te aolak ilukasan mu terong, bare me kierko.
